provenance.machine: Linux x86-64 AMD EPYC Milan VM, one pinned logical CPU, glibc 2.39
provenance.build: Release wheel built from the source distribution with Rust 1.99.0 and maturin 1.15.0
provenance.timed_operation: Parse in-memory UTF-8 response bytes, select links with the page-specific CSS selector, and build an ordered list of (href, descendant text) pairs. Beautiful Soup uses its lxml backend.
provenance.statistic: Arithmetic mean and sample standard error across 12 fresh worker processes per fixture, in microseconds per operation.
provenance.batch: Calibrate from eight iterations to a 12 ms target, then time another batch of the calibrated size. Cyclic GC stays enabled during both batches.
provenance.reproduce: After installing the release wheel and locked dependencies, run benchmarks/run.py --samples 12 --min-sample-ms 12 on one pinned CPU.
